scenario: Helen was discharged from Mercy Hospital on April 2 after treatment for pneumonia. On April 18 she was readmitted to Mercy Hospital for the same pneumonia, 16 days after discharge. The standard inpatient admission copay is $250.
policy: The plan applies a $250 inpatient hospital admission copay to every inpatient admission, except when the admission is a readmission to the same hospital within 30 days of discharge for the same condition, in which case no admission copay applies.
question: What admission copay does Helen owe for the April 18 readmission?
